title: Zero-intrusion install: split harness-owned vs project-progress files

steps: Tests prove project_id is <name>-<8 chars [0-9a-z]>, deterministic per absolute path, and safe for odd names.
Tests prove project state dir resolves to $HARNESS_HOME/<project-id>/ and progress dir to <project>/.harness-mini/.
Tests prove trace.sh, ctx-hook.sh, doctor, status, report, and seed plans use .harness-mini/trace and .harness-mini/docs/exec-plans.
Tests prove .harness-mini/.gitignore ignores trace/runtime and the project .gitignore is byte-identical.
Tests prove installed host skills/agents dirs are listed in .git/info/exclude idempotently.

slices.description: AGENTS.md marker block, global map/docs split, no CLAUDE.md.
steps: Tests prove an existing AGENTS.md outside the block is byte-identical after install and after block removal.
Tests prove a fresh project gets a minimal AGENTS.md holding only the block, and no CLAUDE.md or project ARCHITECTURE.md/docs/harness dirs.
Tests prove static docs and the harness map live under $HARNESS_HOME and architecture.md under .harness-mini/.
Tests prove harness.lock and manifest.md are written under the state dir, not the project.
Tests prove the managed set is skills + agents only and edited files still produce .new on update.
Tests prove `harness.sh agent list` prints supported hosts and `agent install <host>` writes skills and agents to the mapped dirs (shared .agents/skills where the host reads it).
Tests prove an unknown host installs nothing and prints self-install instructions with the source path.

slices.description: Reshuffle source repo and dogfood the new layout.
steps: Tests prove docs/references and docs/assets are not installed or locked.
Focused searches find no active skill/doc path references to project docs/exec-plans or .trace.

slices.description: Automatic migration from the old layout.
steps: Tests prove docs/exec-plans and .trace move into .harness-mini and lock-clean legacy docs/harness/AGENTS/ARCHITECTURE files are removed.
Tests prove edited files and existing targets are preserved, reported, and repeat runs are harmless.

slices.description: Docs, changelog, version bump, L2 evaluation.
steps: README, getting-started, walkthrough, and changelog describe the new layout; VERSION bumped.
bash tests/run.sh passes and a separate L2 evaluation passes.
